scenes: Bitcoin's biggest exchange started as a card game website.
And it lost eight hundred fifty thousand Bitcoin.
Mount Gox meant Magic: The Gathering Online eXchange.
Jed McCaleb made it to trade game cards.
In twenty ten, he turned it into a Bitcoin exchange.
In March twenty eleven, he sold it to Mark Kar-puh-less.
By twenty thirteen, it handled over seventy percent of all Bitcoin transactions.
In February twenty fourteen, trading stopped.
Eight hundred fifty thousand Bitcoin were missing.
Kar-puh-less was arrested in twenty fifteen.
